page.layout: One page of verse in italic, two lines per stanza block as printed; running head at top centre-left with page number at top right; marginal notes in the right margin (Ætna mons., Æolides inf., Chelæ opp., Fastor.lib.4., Acis fl., Ortygia inf.). No catchword or signature.

p.i: {A}At non æquus amat Trinacria Mulciber antra. Non Lipare vastis subter denasta caminis Sulfureum vomit exesō de vertice fumum.

Ast Ætna eructat tremefactis cautibus ignes,Ætna mons. Inclusi gemitus, pelagique imitata furorem, Murmure per cæcos tonat irrequieta fragores Nocte diéque simul, sonte è Phlegetontis ut atro Flammarum exundat torrens, piceaque procella Semiambusta rotat liquefactis saxa cavernis. Sed quanquam largo flammarum exæstuat intus Turbine, & assidue subnascens profluit ignis, Summo canarugo cohibet (mirabile dictu) Vicinam flammis glaciem, aternóque rigore Ardentes horrent scopuli, stat vertice celsi Collis hyems, calidaque niuem tegit atra fauilla.
Quid referam Æolio regnatas nomine terras?Æolides inf. Ventorúmque domos, atque addita claustra procellis? Hic versi penitus Pelopeia ad regna Pachyni Pulsata Ionio respondent saxa profundo.
Hic contra Libyámque situm, Chaurosq, furentes Cernit denexas Lilybaon nobile Chelas.Chelæ opp.
At quà diuersi lateris frons tertia terris Vergit in Italiam prolato ad littora dorso, Celsius arenosa tollit se mole Pelorus.

His longo mitis placido dominator in ævo Præfuerat terris Hieron, tractare sereno Imperio vulgum pollens, & pectora nullo Parentum exagitare metu, pactámque per aras Haud facilis temerare fidem, socialia iura Ausoniis multos seruabat casta per annos.Fastor.lib.4.
Jámque Leontinos, Anisenáque flumina cursu Præterit, & ripas herbifer Aci tuas.Acis fl.

page.notes: Marginal notes are in the right margin beside the verse lines. The bottom line "Pantagieni" and the small mark "T" below the text are faint; the initial letters of stanzas are decorated and some are uncertain. Several words in the rightmost stanza are doubtful and may be misprinted.
